endorsements.name: Michael Prentice
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-25844
endorsements.description: The package angular after 1.7.0 are vulnerable to Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) by providing a custom locale rule that makes it possible to assign the parameter in posPre: ' '.repeat() of NUMBER_FORMATS.PATTERNS[1].posPre with a very high value. **Note:** 1) This package has been deprecated and is no longer maintained. 2) The vulnerable versions are 1.7.0 and higher.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.3)

endorsements.name: Michael Prentice
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-26116
endorsements.description: Versions of the package angular from 1.2.21 are vulnerable to Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) via the angular.copy() utility function due to the usage of an insecure regular expression. Exploiting this vulnerability is possible by a large carefully-crafted input, which can result in catastrophic backtracking.
